summary: Make capability accumulation, Capability Foundry validation and evidence-backed packaging mandatory before registering any new user-facing EKODI service.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform owner explicitly instructed EKODI on 2026-09-23 to make the capability-before-service model a mandatory rule after approving the internal Capability Foundry and Sample Service.
adds: existing Capability search is mandatory before any new user-facing service registration
a capability gap must be addressed in Capability Foundry before service packaging
synthetic sample validation must precede a new service
at least three distinct verified sample runs are required
explicit user demand, measured recurring need, or a security/legal/reliability requirement is required
EKODI Platform Super Administrator packaging review is required
automatic user-facing service creation is forbidden
new service registration without evidence fails CI
new independent deployment boundaries still require the sustainable boundary-creation gate
preserves: all v1.23.0 AI Claim Integrity and Knowledge Claim Gate rules
all existing services as the v1.24.0 adoption baseline only
rollback: Revert only v1.24.0 Capability Before Service policy, its validator, evidence registry and Foundry binding while preserving existing services, Capability modules, user data, and the full v1.23.0 constitution.
verification: Run constitution validation, capability validation, full repository regression tests, orchestration checks and protected-branch guarded merge.
